scope: Real native CLI and optional terminal workspace development; no physical editor, graphical host or human play acceptance.
input_source_scope: Native package, bootstrap, harness, optional starter/core fixtures, legacy contract oracle, native/prevention guides, workflow and formatter selection; excludes local outputs and evidence reports.

measurements.bootstrap_scope: Initially empty dedicated cache. First dependency download attempt was cancelled by executor; this completed-attempt time includes resumed download/compilation and initial application compile failure, so it is not an uninterrupted cold-success measurement.

interactive_contract: POSIX interactive run execs Cabal; normal shell job control owns the process. Interactive tool-level timeout is refused; use captured run --smoke. No private foreground proxy or C stop adapter is distributed.

native_package_unit_suite.scope: CLI/Create/Process tests, including real child Unicode/newline output, positive rejection controls and started-child cancellation

native_formatter.scope: Linux native formatter; Haskell package files and explicit Linux/Darwin/Windows defines on CPP modules

fresh_cabal_cache_path_query.scope: Cabal3.12.1.0 fresh empty configuration; --verbose=0 yields one JSON value instead of first-use initialization prose

additional_validation.windows_runtime: First published revision failed before native build; resolver fix awaits follow-up Windows CI.
additional_validation.macos_runtime: First published revision passed native CI; not executed in this local Linux environment.

windows_bootstrap_regression.scope: Actual PowerShell Get-Command duplicate-match probe, actual -Check invocation, and no-build assertion. Explicitly not applicable on this Linux run.

first_published_native_ci.Windows: bootstrap discovery failed; fix awaiting follow-up CI

prior_findings.foreground_proxy: Controlled reproduction confirmed a late self-stop race. Removing private interactive foreground ownership addresses it; prior proxy passes are not final-architecture evidence.
prior_findings.timing_oracles: Earlier delay-only cancellation evidence remains inconclusive. Shell tests require exact command completion and kernel/Bash stopped acknowledgement; the separate background-start oracle race reproduced with direct Cabal.
